# {Client} {Project} — data model

> Generated by `/list-schemas` with the CSVs in `schemas/` (stage **G5**). The CSV is the column
> definition; this file says **why**, and holds what a CSV can't: volume, threshold strategy,
> archival, permissions, flows. Change both together.

| Volume | Estimated items per year |

## 2. Relationships

A reference stores the target's SharePoint item ID in an indexed Number column `<Target>Id` (never a Lookup,
T-19), plus a display value. Item IDs are not kept when a list is re-created on another site: moving data
between sites means remapping these columns.

| From (list.column) | To (list, by item ID) | Display value kept in |
|---|---|---|
